_comment: Attribute names present in BiH attribute_metadata.json that should be excluded when parsing Vietnam coding tables (the corresponding table columns either don't exist or encode incompatible semantics).
incompatible_with_bh: Pedestrian peak hour flow across the road
Pedestrian peak hour flow along the road passenger-side
Pedestrian peak hour flow along the road driver-side
ignored_from_bh: Pedestrian observed flow across the road
Pedestrian observed flow along the road driver-side
Pedestrian observed flow along the road passenger-side
_comment_bh_to_table_attribute_name: Maps a BiH attribute_metadata.json attribute name to the (differently spelled) header used for it in the Vietnam coding tables. Used to resolve required columns whose Vietnam header does not match the BiH name even after case-insensitive comparison. Output keeps the canonical BiH name.
